The MODIS row is recomputed here from the 72 granules of that study, through the same estimators as the simulations, and restricted to sensor zenith angles below $60^\circ$: beyond that a pixel is several km across and views cloud sides as much as cloud tops, which the per-pixel footprints passed to the estimators cannot repair. That restriction is a deliberate difference from the published analysis, and is the likeliest source of the residual disagreement with it; the nine values that paper reports are nonetheless reproduced to a mean absolute difference of 0.011.
